About SOS Plumbing

A Certified, Skilled Team You Can Count On

For over 38 years, SOS Plumbing has provided the San Gabriel Valley with comprehensive plumbing and piping services. You never know when a plumbing problem will strike — that’s why our highly trained, experienced plumbers are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

We use state-of-the-art technology to find and solve even the toughest plumbing problems, with innovative plumbing and rooter tools that deliver top-quality professional work — guaranteed, every time.

  • Upfront, competitive pricing with clear communication
  • Trained, certified technicians — courteous and respectful in your home
  • Advanced rooter and diagnostic tools for tough jobs
  • Our goal: 100% customer satisfaction on every visit
